measure_design: classicalExpMeasure branches expandedSets := ((branches.zip expandedSets).map (fun p => 3 ^ classicalBranchComplexity p.1 p.2)).sum. Strictly decreases by >=1 per expansion step (alpha 1 child, beta exactly 2 children, each child branchComplexity <= C-1, base 3 absorbs the 2-way split: 3^a0+3^a1+1 <= 3^C). Phi_initial = 3^(phi.complexity) exactly, so fuel bound := 3^(phi.complexity) discharges by le_refl. fuel=0 base case becomes a contradiction (Phi=0 impossible when branches nonempty).
